subject: SIG: Clarification on prompt logs, retention, and training-on-customer-data
messages:
From: Kate Morgan <kate@finovate.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finovate Security Team <security@finovate.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SIG: Clarification on prompt logs, retention, and training-on-customer-data

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for sending the initial SIG spreadsheet. A few follow-ups from our risk team on data handling so we can complete the SIG question set (particularly sections D3/D4):

- Do you retain raw prompts and model outputs (text) by default for hosted API customers? If so, what is the retention period and where are they stored?
- Are logs (request/response pairs and kernel traces) encrypted at rest and who can access them?
- Do you ever use customer prompts/outputs to further train Redwood models or any public models? If yes, under what legal mechanism?
- If a customer requests deletion/purge of logs, what is the process and SLA?

Can you provide the SIG spreadsheet back with answers and any evidence (retention policy, redacted log sample, contract clause) we can attach to our questionnaire?

Appreciate a response this week if possible.

Best,
Kate
Kate Morgan
Security Analyst, Finovate Bank
[Attachment requested: SIG_Questions_Fillable.xlsx]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Morgan <kate@finovate.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 Nov 2025 12:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG: Clarification on prompt logs, retention, and training-on-customer-data

Hi Kate — thanks for the clear list. Answering inline to make it easy for the SIG: 

1) Do you retain raw prompts and model outputs by default?
- Short answer: Yes for hosted API customers, short-term retention. Default retention for production hosted requests is 30 days (used for billing, abuse detection, and debugging). For Dedicated/Private deployments, data retention is controlled by customer config and can be set to 0 days.

2) Storage location and encryption:
- All request/response logs are encrypted at rest using AES-256 with keys managed in our KMS. Logs are stored in region-specific, access-controlled storage buckets (we can provide ARNs/ids in the evidence bundle). Access is limited to a small set of SRE personnel via role-based access; access is audited.

3) Training on customer data:
- Redwood does NOT use customer prompts/outputs to train our public or internal models by default. Model training on customer data only occurs if the customer explicitly opts in and signs our Data Use Addendum (MSA-Addendum-TRAINING-v1). That addendum defines scope, retention, and compensation.

4) Deletion/purge process and SLA:
- Customers may request a purge via an authenticated support ticket. We verify the request (owner + account admins) and perform a scrub within 48 hours of verification for hosted accounts. For Dedicated/Private, scope and SLA are contract dependent.

Attachments I’ve included for the SIG:
- SIG_Questions_Fillable.xlsx (answers filled in the spreadsheet)
- retention_policy.pdf (excerpt of retention policy)
- kernel_log_excerpt.txt (small redacted sample)

Link to evidence folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/compliance/Finovate-SIG-evidence-2025

If you need a formal attestation or specific contract language callouts, looping in Monica (Head of Sales Ops) and Neha (Compliance) — they can help with legal/contract items.

Cheers,
Rishi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SIG_Questions_Fillable.xlsx (XLSX)]

Monica / Kate — confirming details: 

- Contract clause: Section 7.2(b) — "Data Use & Model Training": 
  "Customer Data will not be used for model training or model improvement unless Customer signs the Data Use Addendum (MSA-Addendum-TRAINING-v1)."

- DocuSign route: if Finovate opts in, we’ll send the DUA via DocuSign (link in related_links). Contact on our legal team is Priya Natarajan (cc'd) who handles DUA execution.

- Redaction: Attached is a redacted log sample (redacted_log_excerpt.txt) with request IDs preserved but all PII, IPs, and sensitive tokens removed. 

- Purge API/process note: There is no public API call for immediate irreversible purge; the supported mechanism is an authenticated support ticket (support@redwood.ai) with account owner confirmation — we process within 48 hours and provide an audit record back to the customer.

Attaching: redacted_log_excerpt.txt

Let me know if you need anything else.

Best,
Rishi

We verify account ownership and the account admin, then execute a scrub and return an audit id. SLA: 48 hours after verification.

Logs are encrypted at rest and access is restricted and audited."

If you want a formatted PDF attestation signed by our compliance team we can produce that within 3 business days.

Regards,
Rishi
